title: 芯片限制加码：美银首席反而推动，中国高端制造突围
speaker: Helen Qiao

segments.en: between the US and China, if anything? Well, a tighter sanction on the hardware side is probably going to, you know, present more challenges to the Chinese AI related model training
segments.zh: 中美之间，如果说有影响的话？嗯，硬件方面更严格的限制可能会给中国AI相关的模型训练带来更多挑战。

segments.en: and also the development and also, you know, not only the remote access being banned, but also potentially, you know, expanding the restriction on not only China,
segments.zh: 还有发展方面，而且不仅是远程访问被禁止，还可能扩大限制范围，不仅针对中国，

segments.en: but the whole Asia where, you know, East Asia, that could be another way of seeing the tightening.
segments.zh: 而是整个亚洲，你知道，东亚地区，这可能是另一种收紧的方式。

segments.en: I think that could potentially, yes, you know, hurt Chinese AI development pace in the near future, but at the same time, I would also mention
segments.zh: 我认为这可能在短期内会拖慢中国AI的发展步伐，但同时我也要提到，

segments.en: that probably would also, you know, incentivize the Chinese hardware makers to do as much as possible, as quickly as possible to play catch-up,
segments.zh: 这也可能激励中国硬件制造商尽可能快地迎头赶上，

segments.en: because this is becoming more urgent compared to before.
segments.zh: 因为与之前相比，这变得更加紧迫。

segments.en: So I would say that maybe in the near term, we could see some challenges there, and if there is more news on only hardware sanction,
segments.zh: 所以我想说，短期内我们可能会看到一些挑战，如果有更多关于硬件限制的消息，

segments.en: but also, you know, punishment of software companies or larger platform companies, I think those could be the potential risk on the downside.
segments.zh: 还有对软件公司或大型平台公司的惩罚，我认为这些可能是潜在的下行风险。

segments.en: However, I do think that this is undoubtedly going to propel the development of high-end manufacturing in China so that China can produce its own high-end chips.
segments.zh: 然而，我确实认为这无疑将推动中国高端制造业的发展，使中国能够生产自己的高端芯片。
